evidence.quote: For the Montreal cohort, 50 ml of blood were drawn from each volunteer in sodium-heparinized Vacutainer tubes (BD) on the day of vaccination (day 0) and 3, 7, 10, 14, 28, 60, 90, 180, and 365 d thereafter.
Samples failing chip visual inspection and control examination were removed.
The resulting matrix showing probes as rows and samples as columns was log 2 transformed and used as input for linear modeling using BioConductor Linear models for microarray analysis (LIMMA [ 60 ]).
Changes in gene expression observed by microarray analyses were verified by qPCR.

Stocks of live YF17D virus were prepared in our laboratory by infecting Vero cell monolayers grown in DME medium (Sigma-Aldrich) supplemented with 10% X-Vivo 15 medium (Lonza), with YF17D, and harvesting the culture supernatants when severe histopathology could be observed (6–7 d).
Immature DCs were generated by culturing monocytes for 6 d in the presence of 100 ng/ml GM-CSF (R&D Systems) and 25 ng/ml IL-4 (R&D Systems).
After 24 and 48 h, supernatants were collected and analyzed using an IL-1β ELISA kit (BD).
PBMCs from vaccinated volunteers were labeled with CFSE (Invitrogen), as previously described ( 64 ).
After 24 h of incubation at 37°C/5% CO 2 , 120 μl of supernatant was withdrawn from each tube and frozen at −80°C for subsequent cytokine analysis.
Frozen stocks of autologous PBMCs were used as a source of lymphocytes.
(b) FACS analysis of PBMCs from day 365 after vaccination.
